rows.grounds: instrumental plural ending -aiḥ; compound of six tree names used as ritual substances

items.question: Which six trees are prescribed for the second enclosure purification?
items.inference: the rite employs jambu, shirisha, palasha, saptaparna, asana, and arjuna
uncertainties: exact ritual function of each tree is not specified by this verse
items.plain_english: With jambu, shirisha, palasha, saptaparna, asana, and arjuna.
